description: P2 + P3 (coupled): Execute the real HF NLI model path (facebook/bart-large-mnli) ONCE on both splits and record the real measured numbers next to the mock numbers; and make the harness emit its full results table (six metrics x five systems x both splits) to a committed markdown artifact docs/eval-results.md (as well as stdout). Regenerate docs/eval-results.md AFTER P1 and P2 so it is current. Keep MOCK the default for the zero-setup demo; do NOT change the default path and do NOT add heavy deps to backend/requirements.txt's default demo install.
steps: P3 first (so P2 can populate it): add a report-artifact emitter to backend/finalsay/eval/harness.py that renders the full results (per-field extraction F1, relationship precision/recall/F1, false-confirmation rate, unresolved rate, Cohen's kappa, and time-to-identify incl. recall@k from FEAT-001) as a markdown table for a given split+model, and can write/append to a committed file (default docs/eval-results.md). Add a CLI flag (e.g. `--emit-markdown PATH` or `--report PATH`) so `python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split temporal --report docs/eval-results.md` writes the artifact in addition to stdout. Make it produce a single coherent document covering both splits when run for both (append or a small driver); keep stdout output unchanged in shape.

Install the HF stack into backend/.venv WITHOUT adding it to the default demo install path: `backend/.venv/bin/pip install transformers torch --index-url` as appropriate (CPU torch is fine; OPEN_INTERNET available). Do NOT add transformers/torch to backend/requirements.txt (that file is the zero-setup demo install and must stay light). If you want them recorded, add a SEPARATE optional file (e.g. backend/requirements-hf.txt) documented as opt-in for the HF eval only.

Run the harness ONCE on BOTH splits with the real model: `cd backend && FINALSAY_COMPARISON_MODEL=hf .venv/bin/python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split temporal --model hf` and `--split institution --model hf`. Model weights (facebook/bart-large-mnli, ~1.6GB) download on first run; note the runtime honestly. Capture the REAL measured numbers.

Create/populate docs/eval-results.md with the full table for BOTH splits and BOTH models (mock and hf), each set of numbers CLEARLY LABELLED which is which (mock = default zero-setup; hf = facebook/bart-large-mnli opt-in). Include: the six metrics x five systems for each split, the runtime of the HF run, and the exact setup commands needed to reproduce the HF run (pip install line + env var + harness command). State plainly that MOCK is the default and HF is opt-in.

If the HF stack genuinely cannot be installed or run within budget, do NOT fake numbers: record in docs/eval-results.md and HANDOFF.md exactly what was attempted and why it could not complete, and leave the mock numbers + P1 measured numbers as the committed artifact.

Confirm the default path is unchanged: `cd backend && .venv/bin/python -c "import sys; from finalsay.models_iface.comparison_model import get_comparison_model; m=get_comparison_model(); assert m.name=='mock'; assert 'transformers' not in sys.modules and 'torch' not in sys.modules"` (the default must not import the HF stack).
acceptance_criteria: The harness can emit its full six-metrics x five-systems x both-splits results to docs/eval-results.md via a CLI flag, in addition to stdout.

docs/eval-results.md exists, is committed-ready, is CURRENT (regenerated after FEAT-001's measured time-to-identify), and contains both mock and hf numbers clearly labelled, plus HF runtime and reproduction/setup commands.
The HF model path was actually executed once on both splits and the real numbers recorded (or, if impossible within budget, that is stated plainly with what was attempted; no faked numbers).
MOCK remains the default: backend/requirements.txt is unchanged (no transformers/torch added there); the default get_comparison_model() returns mock and does not import transformers/torch.
make test and both eval splits (mock) stay green.
verification: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split temporal --report docs/eval-results.md; echo exit=$?
cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split institution --report docs/eval-results.md; echo exit=$?

cd backend && .venv/bin/python -c "import sys; from finalsay.models_iface.comparison_model import get_comparison_model; m=get_comparison_model(); assert m.name=='mock'; assert 'transformers' not in sys.modules and 'torch' not in sys.modules; print('default path clean')"
findings: P3: added render_markdown_block / write_report / --report / --report-reset / --report-all to backend/finalsay/eval/harness.py (stdout shape unchanged). Committed artifact docs/eval-results.md carries all 4 labelled blocks (temporal/institution x mock/hf), regenerated post-P1 (recall@k included), plus a header with the two-model explanation, measured HF runtime, honest mock-vs-hf comparison, and exact reproduction commands. P2: the real facebook/bart-large-mnli path WAS executed once on both splits. Documented switch is the env var (FINALSAY_COMPARISON_MODEL=hf); --model hf alone runs mock (verified). Installed torch==2.14.0+cpu (CPU index) + transformers==5.16.1 into backend/.venv ONLY; requirements.txt untouched; heavy deps recorded in new opt-in backend/requirements-hf.txt; HF cache at /projects/sandbox/.hf-cache (gitignored). Runtime CPU-only: temporal ~33s, institution ~28s (weights cached; cold first download adds minutes). MEASURED HF finalsay relationship F1: temporal 0.143 (P/R 0.143/0.143, false_conf 0.000, unresolved 0.714); institution 0.289 (P/R 0.305/0.333, false_conf 0.000, unresolved 0.714). Honest comparison vs MOCK finalsay F1: temporal 0.143 (hf) vs 0.048 (mock); institution 0.289 (hf) vs 0.739 (mock) -> HF is WORSE on the institution split and trails the nli/prompted_llm baselines there; reported as-is, nothing tuned. Model-independent metrics (extraction F1, kappa, baselines, time-to-identify) identical across mock/hf blocks as expected. Verification: default path clean (no transformers/torch import, name=='mock'); requirements.txt unchanged; pytest 57 passed; both mock eval splits exit 0; npm run build green. HANDOFF.md updated with a P2+P3 section. No push, no PR.
